text_en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
text_cn: 在起初已有圣言，圣言与天主同在，圣言就是天主。

text_en: He was in the beginning with God.
text_cn: 圣言在起初就与天主同在。

text_en: All things came into being through him, and without him not one thing came into being. What has come into being
text_cn: 万物是藉着他而造成的；凡受造的，没有一样不是由他而造成的。

text_en: in him was life, and the life was the light of all people.
text_cn: 在他内有生命，这生命是人的光。

text_en: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not overcome it.
text_cn: 光在黑暗中照耀，黑暗决不能胜过他。

text_en: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
text_cn: 曾有一人，是由天主派遣来的，名叫若翰。

text_en: He came as a witness to testify to the light, so that all might believe through him.
text_cn: 这人来，是为作证，为给光作证，为使众人藉他而信。

text_en: He himself was not the light, but he came to testify to the light.
text_cn: 他不是那光，只是为给那光作证。

text_en: The true light, which enlightens everyone, was coming into the world.
text_cn: 那普照每人的真光，正在进入这世界；

text_en: He was in the world, and the world came into being through him; yet the world did not know him.
text_cn: 他已在世界上，世界原是藉他造成的；但世界却不认识他。

text_en: He came to what was his own, and his own people did not accept him.
text_cn: 他来到了自己的领域，自己的人却没有接受他。

text_en: But to all who received him, who believed in his name, he gave power to become children of God,
text_cn: 但是，凡接受他的，他给他们，即给那些信他名字的人权能，好成为天主的子女。

text_en: who were born, not of blood or of the will of the flesh or of the will of man, but of God.
text_cn: 他们不是由血气，也不是由肉欲，也不是由男欲，而是由天主生的。

text_en: And the Word became flesh and lived among us, and we have seen his glory, the glory as of a father’s only son, full of grace and truth.
text_cn: 于是，圣言成了血肉，寄居在我们中间；我们见了他的光荣，正如父独生者的光荣，满溢恩宠和真理。

text_en: (John testified to him and cried out, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me ranks ahead of me because he was before me. ’”)
text_cn: 若翰为他作证呼喊说：“这就是我所说的：那在我以后来的，成了在我以前的，因他原先我而有。”

text_en: From his fullness we have all received, grace upon grace.
text_cn: 从他的满盈中，我们都领受了恩宠，而且恩宠上加恩宠。

text_en: The law indeed was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 因为法律是藉梅瑟传授的，恩宠和真理却是由耶稣基督而来的。

text_en: No one has ever seen God. It is God the only Son, who is close to the Father’s heart, who has made him known.
text_cn: 从来没有人见过天主，只有那在父怀里的独生者，身为天主的，他给我们详述了。

text_en: This is the testimony given by John when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you? ”
text_cn: 这是若翰所作的见证：当时，犹太人从耶路撒冷派遣了司祭和肋未人，到他那里问他说：“你是谁？”

text_en: He confessed and did not deny it, but confessed, “I am not the Messiah. ”
text_cn: 他明明承认，并没有否认；他明认说：“我不是默西亚。”

text_en: And they asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah? ” He said, “I am not. ” “Are you the prophet? ” He answered, “No. ”
text_cn: 他们又问他说：“那么你是谁？你是厄里亚吗？”他说：“我不是。”“你是那位先知吗？”他回答说：“不是。”

text_en: Then they said to him, “Who are you? Let us have an answer for those who sent us. What do you say about yourself? ”
text_cn: 于是他们问他说：“你究竟是谁？好叫我们给那派遣我们来的人一个答复。关于你自己，你说什么呢？”

text_en: He said, “I am the voice of one crying out in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord, ’” as the prophet Isaiah said.
text_cn: 他说：“我是在旷野里呼喊者的声音：修直上主的道路罢！正如依撒意亚先知所说的。”

text_en: Now they had been sent from the Pharisees.
text_cn: 被派遣来的有些是法利塞人。

text_en: They asked him, “Why then are you baptizing if you are neither the Messiah, nor Elijah, nor the prophet? ”
text_cn: 他们又问他说：“你既不是默西亚，又不是厄里亚，也不是那位先知，那么，你为什么施洗呢？”

text_en: John answered them, “I baptize with water. Among you stands one whom you do not know,
text_cn: 若翰答复他们说：“我以水施洗，你们中间站着一位，是你们所不认识的；

text_en: the one who is coming after me; I am not worthy to untie the thong of his sandal. ”
text_cn: 他在我以后来，我却当不起解他的鞋带。”

text_en: This took place in Bethany across the Jordan where John was baptizing.
text_cn: 这些事发生于约但河对岸的伯达尼，若翰施洗的地方。

text_en: The next day he saw Jesus coming toward him and declared, “Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
text_cn: 第二天，若翰见耶稣向他走来，便说：“看，天主的羔羊，除免世罪者！

text_en: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who ranks ahead of me because he was before me. ’
text_cn: 这位就是我论他曾说过：有一个人在我以后来，成了在我以前的，因他原先我而有。

text_en: I myself did not know him; but I came baptizing with water for this reason, that he might be revealed to Israel. ”
text_cn: 连我也不曾认识他，但为使他显示于以色列，为此，我来以水施洗。”

text_en: And John testified, “I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it remained on him.
text_cn: 若翰又作证说：“我看见圣神仿佛鸽子从天降下，停在他身上。

text_en: I myself did not know him, but the one who sent me to baptize with water said to me, ‘He on whom you see the Spirit descend and remain is the one who baptizes with the Holy Spirit. ’
text_cn: 我也不曾认识他，但那派遣我来以水施洗的，给我说：你看见圣神降下，停在谁身上，谁就是那要以圣神施洗的人。

text_en: And I myself have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God. ”
text_cn: 我看见了，我便作证：他就是天主子。”

text_en: The next day John again was standing with two of his disciples,
text_cn: 第二天，若翰和他的两个门徒，又在那里站着，

text_en: and as he watched Jesus walk by, he exclaimed, “Look, here is the Lamb of God! ”
text_cn: 若翰看见耶稣走过，便注视着他说：“看，天主的羔羊！”

text_en: The two disciples heard him say this, and they followed Jesus.
text_cn: 那两个门徒听见他说这话，便跟随了耶稣。

text_en: When Jesus turned and saw them following, he said to them, “What are you looking for? ” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which translated means Teacher), “where are you staying? ”
text_cn: 耶稣转过身来，看见他们跟着，便问他们说：“你们找什么？”他们回答说：“辣彼！──意即师傅──你住在哪里？”

text_en: He said to them, “Come and see. ” They came and saw where he was staying, and they remained with him that day. It was about four o’clock in the afternoon.
text_cn: 他向他们说：“你们来看看罢！”他们于是去了，看了他住的地方；并且那一天就在他那里住下了。那时，大约是第十时辰。

text_en: One of the two who heard John speak and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
text_cn: 西满伯多禄的哥哥安德肋，就是听了若翰的话，而跟随了耶稣的那两人中的一个，

text_en: He first found his brother Simon and said to him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is translated Anointed ).
text_cn: 先去找到了自己的弟弟西满，并向他说：“我们找到了默西亚”──意即基督。

text_en: He brought Simon to Jesus, who looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You are to be called Cephas” (which is translated Peter ).
text_cn: 遂领他到耶稣跟前，耶稣注视着他说：“你是若望的儿子西满，你要叫‘刻法’”──意即伯多禄。

text_en: The next day Jesus decided to go to Galilee. He found Philip and said to him, “Follow me. ”
text_cn: 第二天，耶稣愿意往加里肋亚去，遇到了斐理伯，耶稣便向他说：“你跟随我罢！”

text_en: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
text_cn: 斐理伯是贝特赛达人，与安德肋和伯多禄同城。

text_en: Philip found Nathanael and said to him, “We have found him about whom Moses in the law and also the prophets wrote, Jesus son of Joseph from Nazareth. ”
text_cn: 斐理伯遇到纳塔乃耳，就向他说：“梅瑟在《法律》上所记载和先知们所预报的，我们找着了，就是若瑟的儿子，出身于纳匝肋的耶稣。”

text_en: Nathanael said to him, “Can anything good come out of Nazareth? ” Philip said to him, “Come and see. ”
text_cn: 纳塔乃耳便向他说：“从纳匝肋还能出什么好事吗？”斐理伯向他说：“你来看一看罢！”

text_en: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said of him, “Here is truly an Israelite in whom there is no deceit! ”
text_cn: 耶稣看见纳塔乃耳向自己走来，就指着他说：“看，这确是一个以色列人，在他内毫无诡诈。”

text_en: Nathanael asked him, “Where did you get to know me? ” Jesus answered, “I saw you under the fig tree before Philip called you. ”
text_cn: 纳塔乃耳给他说：“你从哪里认识我呢？”耶稣回答说：“斐理伯叫你以前，当你还在无花果树下时，我就看见了你。”

text_en: Nathanael replied, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel! ”
text_cn: 纳塔乃耳回答说：“辣彼！你是天主子，你是以色列的君王。”

text_en: Jesus answered, “Do you believe because I told you that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than these. ”
text_cn: 耶稣遂说道：“因为我向你说：我看见了你在无花果树下，你就信了吗？你要看见比这更大的事！”

text_en: And he said to him, “Very truly, I tell you, you will see heaven opened and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of Man. ”
text_cn: 又向他说：“我实实在在告诉你们：你们要看见天开，天主的天使在人子身上，上去下来。”
